plain_text:
Command Performance was an Armed Forces Radio Service variety program created during World War II for U.S. service personnel overseas. Built around requests from troops, it brought together leading Hollywood stars, comedians, singers, and orchestras in unsponsored broadcasts.

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Carlos Ramirez (performer on 1 recording), Jack Carson (performer on 1 recording), Jack Oakie (performer on 1 recording), Martha Stewart (host on 1 recording), Peter Lorre (performer on 1 recording), Sydney Greenstreet (performer on 1 recording), and Verna Felton (performer on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to Armed Forces Radio Service (produced for).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include World War II and music and variety performance.
